info.name: Common Room Core Activities Objects API
Get a custom object by ID

params.name: cols
params.description:
Comma-separated list of additional columns to include in the response.
Valid values: `recordKey`. Use `cf_*` to include all custom fields,
or `cf_<id>` for a specific one.

items.docs: Retrieve a specific custom object by its unique identifier.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of objects to return per page

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

params.name: objectTypeId
params.description: Filter objects by prefixed object type ID (format `cot_<number>`)

params.name: segmentId
params.description: Filter objects by prefixed segment ID (format `s_<number>`)

params.name: cols
params.description:
Comma-separated list of additional columns to include in the response.
Valid column values: `recordKey`. Use `cf_*` to include all custom fields,
or `cf_<id>` for a specific one. The meta column `recordCount` can be
requested to return the total number of matching objects in `meta.recordCount`.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of custom objects.
